calls.statement:
WITH p AS (SELECT period_end_date AS d FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 8),
active_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dm.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member dm ON dm.member_key = f.member_key
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE f.sale_date > p.d - INTERVAL 12 MONTH AND f.sale_date <= p.d
)
SELECT m.tier, count(*) AS active_members
FROM dim_member m CROSS JOIN p
JOIN active_ids a ON a.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE m.valid_from <= p.d AND m.valid_to >= p.d AND m.join_date <= p.d
GROUP BY m.tier
ORDER BY CASE m.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
